messages:
marta_cust: Attempted to pay invoice INV-8932 via our portal — card declined. Customer sees 'Authentication failed (ACS_TIMEOUT)'. Last4=4242. Payment page showed spinning 3DS modal. Can you escalate?

jess_support: Sorry about that. Can you share the invoice id and exact time of the attempt? Any screenshot would help. We'll pull gateway logs.

marta_cust: INV-8932, attempted at 2024-06-12 16:04:05 UTC. Screenshot: https://files.example.com/snap-INV-8932.png. Customer insists there were funds on the card.

payments_bot: AUTOMATED: payment_attempt_id=pay_01G8HTFZ; gateway_response=402 card_declined; reason=insufficient_funds; gateway_error_code=card_declined.insufficient_funds; acs_status=timeout; acs_transaction_id=acs_9f8a; route=acquirer-eu-1.

alex_ops: Looking at gateway traces: we see a latency spike 16:03:55 -> 16:04:10 on acs-proxy; several ACS callbacks exceeded 15s and returned 504. Could explain ACS timeout and downstream decline.

jess_support: <@alex_ops> can you paste the trace snippet? Need to confirm whether timeout originated inside our proxy or from the issuer ACS.

alex_ops: Trace snippet:
```
[16:03:58.345] -> POST /payments/pay_01G8HTFZ -> acs-proxy forward to issuer
[16:04:16.412] <- 504 from issuer-callback (timed out after 18000ms)
stack: gateway -> acs-proxy -> issuer
```
Suggest temporary mitigation: retry flow for customers if ACS returns timeout rather than categorizing as hard decline.

jess_support: Tried a manual retry in staging with similar card number (masked) — got ACS modal then instant error. Marta, can you ask the customer to retry now? If they have another card we can use that while ops investigates.

marta_cust: Customer retried at 16:12 UTC, still failed with 'card_declined'. They also reported the 3DS window showed 'Unable to complete authentication' instantly.

ops_oncall: Created INC-2024-176 for acs-proxy CPU contention and downstream issuer slowness. Rerouting traffic to alternate ACS proxy pool now. ETA ~25m. No charge posted so no billing impact from our side yet.

jess_support: For short term, can finance accept manual settlement if customer agrees to offline payment? @finance_bot please advise.

finance_bot: Finance: we can process manual settlement if customer provides alternate payment method on a recorded phone payment. Need approval from account owner/sales for credit hold.

marta_cust: Customer switched to AMEX and the payment succeeded at 16:37 UTC. Please keep us updated on root cause and whether any refunds or reversals are needed.

alex_ops: Preliminary root cause: acs-proxy CPU contention + upstream issuer slowdown -> ACS callbacks exceeded our 15s window -> gateway treated as decline (insufficient_funds code from acquirer). Action items: scale ACS proxy, extend callback window for affected acquirers, and improve error message UX when ACS times out. Will post full postmortem.

jess_support: :thumbsup: Marking resolved for now. I'll follow up with the customer and add repro steps to the ticket.
